label: Wat Hang Chat

scripts.label: Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา

samples: Tasawala, Himmapan, Tanakhan, Wanapawet, Cucok, Culawannana, Mahawannana, Kummal

lede: Wat Hang Chat accounts for 13 catalogued manuscripts, 5 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Lampang (100% of the corpus for this temple). Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. Dated witnesses run 1666–1878 CE (4 of 13 carry a date).
